referenceReplayCaveat: calibrated/blended target forecasts are out-of-time, using current runtime calibration. Runtime calibration recalculates strictly past forecasts without guaranteeing they are out-of-sample relative to the fitted model, using their realized xG/outcomes. These stages are a runtime reference. Chronological oosCalibrated fits calibration using prior out-of-sample forecasts and is the primary stage.
weighting: Log-loss and Brier average selection losses within each match, then weight every paired match equally. ECE uses all paired selection observations.
pairing: Same match ID, stage, finite canonical selection key and observed binary outcome; no zero imputation; blended stages restricted to selections with real entry prices on both sides.
uncertainty: 2000 deterministic paired cluster resamples, league strata, whole league-season clusters. Coarser dependence-preserving primary; weekly model-fold bootstrap is supplied separately as sensitivity. Seasons can remain dependent across years and only five are observed; inference is exploratory. Simultaneous CI is not claimed. Holm correction separately for each family-stage candidate comparison set.
improvementSign: Negative delta means lower loss and improvement.
oddsCaveat: Historical football-data opening prices are retrospective market evidence, not proof of executable entry prices or achievable betting returns. No ROI/CLV inferred.

candidateDefinitions.label: Home advantage per-squadra: fit congiunto supportato
candidateDefinitions.limitation: Exact supported fit; current applyHomeAdvantageScale halves only global HA, not per-team parameters. This direct hypothetical wiring has a scaling confound; report explicitly.

candidateDefinitions.label: Controllo HA per-squadra: stessa scala globale applicata alla mappa
candidateDefinitions.limitation: New explicit methodological control, not a historical discarded variant: scales each fitted per-team HA by current model.homeAdvantageScale while retaining the already scaled global HA.

candidateDefinitions.limitation: Documented closed-form centered hypothesis reconstructed; no archived runner. Conditioning uses structural lambda without target xG, levelCorrection excluded as structural definition.

candidateDefinitions.label: Dynamic xG globale: griglia 0.4/0.6/0.8/1, validazione temporale interna
candidateDefinitions.limitation: Documented auto-weight hypothesis reconstructed; exact old scratchpad/grid unavailable. Raw seven-key ensemble log-loss chooses weight on last 120 strictly past matches, then refit on full past training.

primaryBootstrapClusterDescription: Whole league-season blocks; five seasons resampled within each of five league strata. Actual sample-specific counts are reported on each summary row.
aggregation: Single streaming pass partitions result records by variant, then loads baseline plus one candidate only; applies Holm globally by family and stage.
scopeCaveat: Forecasts reconstructed from available historical source data. No historical ingest timestamps, promotion priors, absence/lineup revisions or adaptive-tuning history; shared omissions apply to baseline and candidate.
reportingCaveat: The present experiment was explicitly requested to reopen rejected hypotheses because the current model differs. No operational algorithms, settings or DB rows are modified.
